name: Employee leave management
requirement: Create an employee leave-management screen. Show annual and sick-leave balances. Allow an employee to select a leave type, start date, end date, and enter a reason. Include required-field and date validation, submission and cancellation actions, previous request history, manager approval or rejection, and request status. Generate only the leave-management screen content.

name: Domestic fund transfer
requirement: Create an internet-banking domestic fund-transfer screen. Let the customer select a source account and registered beneficiary, view available balance, enter amount and optional remarks, review details, confirm or cancel, and see a success or failure result. Generate only this screen.

name: Patient appointment booking
requirement: Create a patient appointment-booking screen. Allow the patient to select a medical specialty, doctor, appointment date, and available time slot, enter an optional visit reason, review details, confirm or cancel, and see a booking result. Generate only this screen.

name: Customer registration
requirement: Create a customer-registration screen. Collect full name, email, mobile number, date of birth, residential address, password and confirmation, terms acceptance, validation, register and cancel actions, and a registration result. Generate only this screen.

name: E-commerce checkout
requirement: Create an e-commerce checkout screen. Let customers review cart items, update quantity, provide a delivery address, choose delivery and payment methods, review totals, place or cancel the order, and see confirmation. Generate only this screen.

name: Flight booking
requirement: Create a flight-booking search screen. Allow origin, destination, departure and return dates, passenger count, cabin class, search, flight selection, review, and booking confirmation. Generate only this screen.

name: Insurance claim submission
requirement: Create an insurance-claim submission screen. Collect policy number, incident type and date, description, claim amount, supporting documents, declaration, submit or cancel actions, and submission result. Generate only this screen.

name: Customer support ticket
requirement: Create a customer-support ticket screen. Let the customer select category and priority, enter subject and description, attach context, submit or cancel, and see ticket number and status. Generate only this screen.

name: Event registration
requirement: Create an event-registration screen. Show event summary, collect attendee contact details, ticket type and quantity, accessibility needs, terms acceptance, register or cancel actions, and confirmation. Generate only this screen.

name: Loan application
requirement: Create a loan-application screen. Collect loan type and amount, applicant personal and employment details, income, repayment term, declarations, application review, submit or cancel actions, and result. Generate only this screen.
